$comment: Entry schema for contributes.globalShortcuts (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_global_shortcuts.go; the CLI mirrors it in tools/mincode-cli/global_shortcuts.go. Each entry declares a system-wide shortcut that is off by default: the host registers it only after the user turns it on in Settings > Keyboard shortcuts, and the user may change the key there. key is a accelerator (modifiers CmdOrCtrl, Cmd/Command (= CmdOrCtrl), Ctrl, OptionOrAlt/Option/Alt, Shift, Super, joined by + to one key: a printable ASCII character, Plus, or a named key such as F1-F35, Space, Tab, Enter, Escape, Delete, Page Up), at most {{limits.keyMaxLength}} characters, with at least one modifier other than Shift and not a reserved system shortcut on any platform (lists.reservedAccelerators); a default key also must not be an application-standard combination such as CmdOrCtrl+C or CmdOrCtrl+S (lists.reservedDefaultAccelerators; any extra Shift or Alt makes it allowed), although the user may still pick one in the settings. run.type view opens one of the plugin's tab views (not a floating view) and focuses MinCode; run.type action calls one of the plugin's contributes.actions that is uiCallable and not dangerous, with the fixed JSON object payload (at most {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}} bytes, no trigger key) plus {"trigger": {"type": "globalShortcut", "id": id}}, so the action's maxPayloadBytes must leave {{limits.triggerReserveBytes}} bytes for it; run.type floating shows or hides one of the plugin's views that declares floating.
description: Global shortcuts: system-wide keys the user can turn on to open a plugin view, toggle a floating view, or run a plugin action while MinCode is in the background.

key.description: Default accelerator, for example CmdOrCtrl+Shift+A. The user may change it.

view.description: One of this plugin's contributes.views ids without floating.

action.description: One of this plugin's contributes.actions ids that is uiCallable and not dangerous.

payload.description: Fixed JSON object sent with every trigger (compact JSON within limits.payloadMaxBytes of the contract) without a trigger key.

view.description: One of this plugin's contributes.views ids that declares floating.
